course.title: Statistics for Planners-I
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: The number of flaws in a fibre optic cable follows a Poisson Distribution. The (11) average number of flaws in 50m of cable is 1.5
i. What is the probability of exactly three flaws in 200m of cable?
ii. What is the probability of at least two flaws in 100m of cable?
jii. What is the probability of exactly one fiaw in the first 50m of cable and exactly one flaw in the second 50m of cable?
